title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion on 1972-11-19
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips 2 track/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24; Reels supplied and Transferred By David Gans; Mastered By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a soaring Nov ’72 set highlighted by a monster Dark Star, Weather Report Suite and stellar Phil bass.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, gorgeous sound and a mix that lets Phil’s booming bass shine. Musically the show is fire‑hot, with a long Dark Star solo, superb Box→Playin', an inspired Weather Report Suite, and a standout Birdsong, all delivered with high energy.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers give 4–5 stars, emphasizing exceptional performance and excellent soundboard quality; the weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear, gorgeous sound; mix highlights Phil’s bass; no reported dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a post‑Bertha opener and seamless transitions, especially the Box→Playin' sequence.

band_member_comments.Phil: Long solo on Dark Star; bass is cranked up and described as a fan's fantasy mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted lyric change on Me & My Uncle ("I grabbed a bottle, cracked him in the jaw").
